proposed.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
proposed.text: At Karen's request, Frank waits at Matt's apartment to protect him, and the two fight off Fisk's Anti-Vigilante Task Force together, though they still argue over killing.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clashes with Frank over killing, yet defends him at trial and later fights beside him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A vigilante Matt clashes with over killing, then fights beside against Fisk's task force.

changes.evidence: Born Again S1#9 'Straight to Hell': Castle is waiting in Murdock's apartment, saying someone asked him to keep Murdock safe; they fight off the AVTF raid together, argue over killing North, escape the grenade and reunite with Page, who had asked Castle to protect Murdock. A new alliance after the Daredevil S2 rivalry (S1#4 is only a talk).

proposed.title: The Punisher S1#10
proposed.text: Frank finds Lewis holding Karen hostage in a bomb vest at Senator Ori's hotel, helps her get free, and leaves Lewis to blow himself up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Troubled veteran turned bomber, whom Frank stops. Blows himself up.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hunts Lewis down, then leaves him to blow himself up.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S1#10 'Virtue of the Vicious': Wilson attacks Ori's hotel and takes Page hostage with a dead man's switch; Castle confronts him, helps Page get free, and Wilson blows himself up. Their story ends with his death, which has no stage (the only stage is S1#9).

now.title: Jessica Jones S3#12
now.text: Gregory Sallinger is a serial killer who murders Dorothy Walker and kidnaps Jessica. Jessica works to put him away, and Trish ends up killing him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Investigator Sallinger kidnaps, who works to put him away.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Serial killer who kills Dorothy and kidnaps Jessica.

proposed.text: Sallinger drugs Jessica and ties her up in her own office to photograph her confession, but she secretly records him admitting to killing Dorothy Walker and hands him to the police. Trish kills him before he reaches court.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Investigator Sallinger ties up and tortures, who records his confession and turns him in.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Serial killer who kills Dorothy and ties up and tortures Jessica.

changes.evidence: Jessica Jones S3#12 'A.K.A. A Lotta Worms': Sallinger poisons Jessica's whiskey, ties her up at the Alias Investigations office and tortures her for a 'confession'. Jessica's hidden camera records him confessing to Dorothy's murder, and she subdues him and leaves him for the police. He never kidnaps her. (Dorothy's murder is in S3#8.)

The two never share a title, and nothing on screen ties them. The only link is one line in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#16 'Paradise Lost', where James says he always knew Jiaying would send someone for him and assumed it would be Gordon. That is knowing about Gordon's role. That Gordon identified James and brought him into Afterlife comes from the fandom bio, and the episode recap does not show it on screen.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
proposed.text: Ward has Jemma tortured to force Fitz to guide his Hydra team through the portal, and on Maveth Fitz has to beg Ward to spare him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Former friend Ward drops into the ocean, and later forces to guide him on Maveth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra traitor who drops Fitz into the ocean, and later forces him through the portal.

changes.evidence: S3#9 'Closure': Giyera tortures Simmons so Ward can make Fitz explain the portal, and Fitz agrees to go through it. S3#10 'Maveth': Ward's Hydra team is guided by Fitz on Maveth; Fitz begs Ward not to kill him and promises 'Daniels' will show the way; Ward dies there at Coulson's hands. Nothing between them after S1#21 has a stage.
